source.title: Alsa - Desert Flare
source.name: Alsa
source.description: A graceful Mage skilled at outmaneuvering opponents.

skills.name: Twirling Rocks

description.raw: Alsa curls into a ball and moves to the target tile, dealing 300% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage to adjacent enemies. Afterward, she enters Combat Stance until the battle ends. In Combat Stance, she consumes 500 Energy to cast Vigorous Slam, hitting the targets and dealing 260% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage, stunning them for 2s. Alsa prioritizes Swift Evasion to deal 150% (ATK-based) + 5% (SP-based) damage to adjacent enemies when attacked, reducing their movement speed by 60% for 2s. Alsa rolls away from attackers afterward, gaining a shield equal to 25% of max HP for 7s. This effect occurs once every 7s at most. Alsa becomes immune to control effects when curling into a ball.
active: Alsa curls into a ball and moves to the target tile, dealing 300% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage to adjacent enemies.

Alsa rolls away from attackers afterward, gaining a shield equal to 25% of max HP for 7s.
This effect occurs once every 7s at most.
Alsa becomes immune to control effects when curling into a ball.

skills.description_lite: Enters Combat Stance, gaining enhanced flexibility in dealing damage and dodging attacks.

skills.name: Stone Barrier

description.raw: Alsa channels the power of Earth Force to blast the nearest enemy target, dealing 270% (ATK-based) + 25% (SP-based) damage and stunning them for 2 + 0.25 (SP-based)s. The blast creates earth pillars 3 tiles behind this target and knocks back enemies on those tiles by 1 tile. A maximum of 6 pillars can be present on the field.
active: Alsa channels the power of Earth Force to blast the nearest enemy target, dealing 270% (ATK-based) + 25% (SP-based) damage and stunning them for 2 + 0.25 (SP-based)s.
The blast creates earth pillars 3 tiles behind this target and knocks back enemies on those tiles by 1 tile.
A maximum of 6 pillars can be present on the field.

skills.description_lite: Alsa deals damage to an enemy and creates earth pillars on the field.

skills.name: Rolling Boulder

description.raw: Alsa senses the vibrations of leylines to locate all enemies recently affected by control effects, then drops boulders on them, dealing 250% (ATK-based) + 25% (SP-based) damage.
active: Alsa senses the vibrations of leylines to locate all enemies recently affected by control effects, then drops boulders on them, dealing 250% (ATK-based) + 25% (SP-based) damage.

skills.description_lite: Alsa deals damage to all enemies recently affected by control effects.

description.raw: Increases Haste by 10 during battles, gaining an extra 6 Haste after entering the Combat Stance status.
active: Increases Haste by 10 during battles, gaining an extra 6 Haste after entering the Combat Stance status.

text: Increases Haste by 14 during battles, gaining an extra 7 Haste after entering the Combat Stance status.
Increases Haste by 18 during battles, gaining an extra 8 Haste after entering the Combat Stance status.

skills.name: Don of Terra

description.raw: Alsa increases the damage of Vigorous Slam by 50% (ATK-based) after dealing damage with the skill, stacking up to 2 times. She also increases the shield value of Swift Evasion by 5% of her max HP after casting it, stacking up to 2 times.
active: Alsa increases the damage of Vigorous Slam by 50% (ATK-based) after dealing damage with the skill, stacking up to 2 times.
She also increases the shield value of Swift Evasion by 5% of her max HP after casting it, stacking up to 2 times.

text: Unlocks at Exclusive Weapon Level 5: Reduces the Energy cost to 400 when the Vigorous Slam buff is stacked to its maximum.
Reduces the cooldown to 6s when the Swift Evasion buff is stacked to its maximum.
Increases the damage dealt by the next Vigorous Slam by 55% (ATK-based).
This effect can stack up to 2 times.

skills.description_lite: Increases combat capabilities under the Combat Stance.
